qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High regulatory switching costs on FDA-validated device contract sterilization (AST) and closed-loop hospital sterile processing consumables enable consistent 2-3%+ annual price increases across cycles. Tangible ROIC >25-32% proves moat despite non-cash goodwill/PPA amortization.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global infection-prevention and contract device sterilization duopoly/toll booth with ~80% recurring revenue across hospital consumables, AST contract processing, and service agreements. High regulatory switching costs (FDA-validated sterilization protocols) and closed-loop hospital SPD workflows protect durable pricing power (2-3% annual price increases). Tangible ROIC >25-32% demonstrates true underlying capital efficiency masked at GAAP level by Cantel PPA amortization. Balance sheet de-levered to 1.5x Net Debt/Owner FCF and 18x interest coverage post-HuFriedy dental divestiture. [5-10Y g: surgical & AST procedural volume 4.0% + pricing power 2.5% + high-margin AST/bioprocessing mix 1.0% - EPA regulatory/labor cost drag 0.5% + capital return & bolt-ons 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year tangible ROIC averaged 25-45% (FY2025 tangible ROIC 32.1%, operating ROIC 24.5%; GAAP ROIC of 7-10% suppressed by Cantel Medical non-cash PPA amortization). Multi-year Owner FCF conversion exceeds 135% (FY2025 Owner FCF $910.7M vs GAAP NI $782.3M, OCF $1,341.4M). Core segments: Healthcare (infection prevention capital equipment, SPD chemistries, endoscopy maintenance), Applied Sterilization Technologies (AST contract radiation/EO sterilization toll booth, >$1B revenue, >$500M operating profit), and Life Sciences (biopharma contamination control). Successfully completed $787.5M divestiture of non-core dental segment (HuFriedyGroup) to Peak Rock Capital in 2024, deploying proceeds to de-lever balance sheet from $3.1B to $1.8B LT debt. Net Debt/Owner FCF stands at 1.51x and EBIT interest coverage is 18.2x ($1,101.8M EBIT vs $60.7M interest). Peak Owner EPS compounded at 13.9% CAGR from $1.45 (FY2016) to $9.12 (FY2025).
